name: sum_le_preVariationFun_of_subset

name: exists_Finpartition_sum_ge
statement: Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) (h : preVariationFun f s ≠ ⊤) : ∃ P : Finpartition (⟨s, hs⟩ : Subtype MeasurableSet), preVariationFun f s ≤ ∑ p ∈ P.parts, f p + ε
